init.title: Nilan Connect
init.description: Change the unit's settings, or map it.

settings.title: Level of values
settings.description:
Choose which of the unit's values get an entity.

- **Verified**: only values read on a unit of this model.
- **Documented**: also values from the manufacturer's documentation. This is the default.
- **Test**: every value, also those inferred from the order of Nilan's manual, and values tried in place of others or new. They have not been confirmed on a unit of this model: they may be wrong, and changing one may change a different setting. If you test, please [report]({report_url}) whether they match your unit's panel.

data_description.level: Each entity's attribute Certainty says how certain its value is.

map_start.title: Map the unit
map_start.description:
Recognised: **{unit}** (ventilation). Make changes on this unit - its panel or its app - not on other devices in the house.

Mapping finds out what the unit's registers mean, with your help. First every address of the unit is scanned once, from 0 to 299; that takes from seconds to a few minutes on a slow gateway. Then you write down what the unit's own panel or the manufacturer's app shows, one value at a time, and the unit is read each time you save one. Or you make tests: you change one thing on the panel or in the app, and the guide shows which registers changed. A test reads the unit just before and just after the change, in a few seconds each. Nothing is written to the unit.

When you finish, the mapping is saved with the unit. To send it to us, download the diagnostics and attach the file to a [mapping report]({report_url}).

data.fitted: Is any extra equipment fitted we should know about?

data_description.fitted: Such as a heat pump, a preheater or a CO2 sensor. Leave it empty if there is none, or you do not know.

map_found.title: Scan done
map_found.description:
Mapping **{unit}** (ventilation).

Registers found:

{found}

The scan is saved. Now you can help in two ways: write down what the unit's panel shows, value by value - the easiest - or make tests, each showing what one change on the unit does. Finish when you are done — you can send the mapping to us through the diagnostics.

map_reading.title: Write what the panel shows
map_reading.description:
Mapping **{unit}** (ventilation).

{saved}

Look at this unit's own panel or app, and write one thing it shows right now, or what you just did. The unit is read when you press *Save*, so save straight away.

Leave both fields empty and press *Save* to stop.

data_description.what: Choose, or write your own, e.g. "T7" or "I set level 4".
data_description.value: As the panel shows it, e.g. 8 or 21.5. May be empty.

map_test.title: New test
map_test.description:
Mapping **{unit}** (ventilation). Make changes on this unit - its panel or its app - not on other devices in the house.

**Step 1 of 2: Choose what you will test.** Don't make the change yet - when you press *Start test*, the unit is read as it is now.

map_change.title: Make the change
map_change.description: **Step 2 of 2: Make the change now** on the {unit} (its panel or its app). Wait if the test needs it, then press *Scan*.

map_result.title: What changed

data_description.more: Write after each "=" what the register is; a line of its own belongs to the register above it. A register whose line you leave empty or delete stores nothing.

map_tested.title: What next?
map_tested.description:
Mapping **{unit}** (ventilation).

Saved. Write what the panel shows, make a test, look through all values, or finish.

map_values.title: All values, page {page} of {pages}

map_send.title: Finish and save
map_send.description:
Mapping **{unit}** (ventilation).

At the end we scan every address once more, to catch registers that only appeared during the tests. Last time it took {duration}.

options.nothing_changed: Nothing changed during the test. The function may be switched off by another setting - for example the after-heating is off. Switch it on, and test again.

testing_points.title: {name} tests values not confirmed on a {model}
testing_points.description:
{name} uses the Test level: some of its values are inferred from the order of Nilan's manual or tried in place of others, and have not been confirmed on a {model}. Please [report]({report_url}) whether they match your unit's panel, and attach the diagnostics, which list them.

To stop testing, choose another level in the options of Nilan Connect; this message then goes away.
